<!-- docs-drift-check -->
### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **2** package(s): `@objectstack/mcp`, `@objectstack/service-knowledge`, touching **26** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/mcp/vitest.config.ts`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**20** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json e8740c55f0eaba7571c16a5588c833fe29e176ac`.

⛔ **5** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/mcp/vitest.config.ts`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **1** anchor(s) matched too much of the corpus to be a work list: `VALIDATION_ERROR (literal, 39 pages)`
- **4** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **69** of **252** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **183** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **183**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **124** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **13** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json e8740c55f0eaba7571c16a5588c833fe29e176ac` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `0aa1be7c32a6d38e81eff394b446644c5cc2da3a` — the merge of head `44e00dcf1b4ff8bdda1910184d03f2c0fbed1ea7` into base `e8740c55f0eaba7571c16a5588c833fe29e176ac`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 0aa1be7c32a6d38e81eff394b446644c5cc2da3a && git checkout 0aa1be7c32a6d38e81eff394b446644c5cc2da3a
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin e8740c55f0eaba7571c16a5588c833fe29e176ac 44e00dcf1b4ff8bdda1910184d03f2c0fbed1ea7 && git checkout -B drift-repro e8740c55f0eaba7571c16a5588c833fe29e176ac && git merge --no-ff 44e00dcf1b4ff8bdda1910184d03f2c0fbed1ea7

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json e8740c55f0eaba7571c16a5588c833fe29e176ac
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs e8740c55f0eaba7571c16a5588c833fe29e176ac` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

repo:cloud#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbW5anP6GDaVi5LKi2U

## 维护者速读

- 这个改动给 AI 用的知识检索工具加了三个参数：只在指定记录里搜、按记录返回、按字段分组返回。代码本身复核下来是对的：权限没有被放宽，隐藏的知识源不会被探出来，被过滤掉的条数也不会告诉 AI。
- 复核结论：退回补一轮，暂不排队。原因有两类：一是工具说明和文档里有一句话与实际行为不符（按字段分组时，文件类知识源其实仍会返回结果，说明里写的是"不返回"）；二是有三处安全相关的行为目前没有测试守住，以后被改坏不会报警。
- 另外发现一件不属于本次改动的事：通过 MCP 调用时，参数格式错误大多由 MCP 协议层先拦下，它的报错会把调用方写错的参数名原样带回。这是所有 MCP 工具早就有的行为，建议另开一张卡处理，不挡这个改动。
- 需要您做的：无。

## 席位核对

REWORK — the executor is correct against K9 rules 2, 3, 5 and 6 and every check at the head is green, but one sentence of the definition's description (repeated in the docs and the changeset) is false for `file` / `http` sources under `groupBy`, and three security-bearing behaviours have no failing test. Five findings, M1 and S2 to S5, graded in the contract record below, and four nits; a delta round follows.

Head-sha: `1ebae53960989f6bd358a07034859776dac31625`

First review of this PR. Five commits on merge base `db77cc493abf5a5553e2ef52969e246b37c3c8b5`; 8 files, +713 / -17. `main` is 8 commits ahead at `ff6f9768`; none of them touches `packages/services/service-knowledge`, `packages/mcp`, the spec contracts or `packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts`. Head re-read at 2026-11-26T02:27Z: unchanged.

**形态**
- Open, draft, base `main`, first line `Fixes #37311`, the only closing keyword in the body. Body and changeset read `Clause-②: yes` · `Metadata-protocol: none`. `Fixes` is right: card items 1 to 5 are all in the diff.
- Not governed surface: `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 37393` reads 0 of 8 paths on the register, 730 changed lines, under the 3000 threshold.
- All 8 paths are inside the claim as amended at 01:15Z (comment 7179559203): the definition file and its test, the MCP test, and for that test only the `packages/mcp` devDependency, its lockfile importer line and one vitest alias; the docs page; the changeset.
- `l1-face.mjs --pr 37393` flags one item: `@objectstack/mcp` is published and has no changeset entry. Judged below under 接受的偏差.
- No transport source file is in the diff: `mcp-http-tools.ts`, `stdio-data-bridge.ts` and `packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts` are untouched.

**门禁 check-runs** (at `1ebae539`, read 2026-11-26T02:14Z, every run read by name)
- 75 check-runs: 64 success, 11 skipped, 0 failed, 0 pending. `pr-state.mjs` reads all 11 skips as expected skips. Lint & Repo Gates: success. TypeScript Type Check: success. Test Core and all ten shards: success. Test UI and all sixteen shards: success. Check Changeset: success. Governed Surface Queue Guard: success.
- The dev's count, 62 success and 9 skips, is an earlier reading of the same head; the body owes a refresh (nit 6).
- Local at `1ebae539`, in a scratch worktree, removed afterwards: `knowledge-tools.test.ts` 54/54; `mcp-knowledge-tools.test.ts` 17/17. Both needed built dependencies here (`@objectstack/metadata-core` for the first, `@objectstack/core` for the second), so the report's "no dist involved" is not what this seat measured. The two full package suites: not measured by this seat; the CI shards stand for them.

**逐项核对与消融** (27 single-change ablations at this head, each restored with an empty `git diff HEAD`)
1. The three options reach the service — `scope`, `granularity` and `groupBy` each removed from `searchOpts`: 4, 2 and 3 red in the service-knowledge file, and 1 red each over MCP.
2. The door's bounds — the NUL check removed: 3 red. The 255 bound removed: 3 red. An empty scope admitted: 1 red. An entry with no ids admitted: 1 red. An unknown entry key admitted: 1 red. `groupBy` with `chunk` admitted: 1 red. Every one of the 22 refusal rows asserts `code` and `status`.
3. The hit whitelist — `docHash` added: 2 red. `metadata` added: 3 red. `chunkId` added: 3 red. `headingPath` dropped: 1 red.
4. No count — a `filtered` member added to the answer: 3 red (the whole-answer case and both withheld-source cases).
5. `aiExposed` — the filter removed: 9 red. The withheld adapter is never asked, pinned for `scope` and for `groupBy`.
6. The 64-character cut removed: 1 red. The five-string cap removed: 1 red.
7. NOT pinned — the JSON quoting replaced by plain double quotes: 54/54 green. No case sends a short string holding a quote or a control character to a refusal that repeats it.
8. NOT pinned — the field guard of `groupValue` (`metadataFields` lists the field, object source only) removed: 54/54 green. The dev's "groupValue never set" ablation pins that the value is present, not that it is gated.
9. NOT pinned — a transport-side edit in `registerKnowledgeTools` that deletes `maxLength` from `object`, the ids and `groupBy` and rewrites `groupBy`'s description: 17/17 green over MCP. The case compares HTTP with stdio (one registration function serves both), the description, the key set and part of `scope`. A transport that adds an argument: 1 red.
10. Probe, the listed schema against the real definition — `tools/list` over HTTP, keys sorted, equals `getKnowledgeToolDefinitions()[0].parameters` plus one member, `$schema`. So the whole-schema pin of item 9 is one `toEqual`.
11. Probe, `groupBy` with an exposed `file` source — the file source answers one hit per document with no `groupValue`, for a field the object source lists and for a field no source lists. This is the service's rule (#37103 item 3) and the description says the opposite.
12. Probe, 14 refusals over MCP HTTP and stdio — both doors answer the same text in every case. A NUL in an id, an object or `groupBy`, `groupBy` with `chunk`, and an unknown source id reach the executor and answer its coded text. An empty scope, an entry with no ids, a string over 255, an unknown `granularity` and an unknown key are refused by the SDK's schema check before the executor: `MCP error -32602: Input validation error`, naming the path, with no `code` and no `status`. For an unknown key that text repeats the key as sent: 300 characters, a raw newline and a raw NUL, nine keys listed.

**dev 三条备注的裁定**
1. An empty scope and an entry with no ids refused at the door — accepted. "Bounded as row 11 bounds it" is met: 10 entries and 500 ids, the service's numbers. The door only narrows what it takes, as it already does for an empty `sourceIds`, and K8's note is kept: an empty scope is never read as no filter. It is safe: `parseInput` runs before the service or its sources are read, so the refusal is the same sentence whatever sources exist, withheld or absent, and it repeats nothing but `object` of the same entry, quoted and cut. The door refuses everything the service's `readSearchScope` refuses, so the service's own scope refusal, which repeats a key unquoted, cannot be reached through the tool.
2. `groupValue` as stored, typed `unknown` — accepted, with S2. The value is `metadata[groupBy]` of the lead hit of the group. Three gates stand before it: source admission asks that the caller may query every `metadataFields` member (`admitSourceFields`); the lead hit's record is re-read as the caller; and the freshness check drops a record whose recomputed hash differs, and metadata is in the hash. So it is the value of a field the caller may query, on a record the caller may read, equal to the live value wherever the adapter stores a hash. It is the index copy, on the same footing as the snippet; it is not re-read as the caller, as the title is. A list, a number and an object all pass through as stored (probed). A lookup's value is the parent's id, which the K8 note already lets the caller filter on. What can leak is only what the guard in `hitOf` stops: a `file` / `http` hit's adapter metadata. That guard has no test.
3. `sourceIds` items without `maxLength` — accepted, no change here. An id is trimmed and looked up in the map of exposed sources; an unknown one is refused before any adapter, statement or log line sees it, and the refusal cuts it. A bound on an existing argument is a narrowing and not this card's.

**逐句核的散文面**
- Changeset: the sentence on `groupBy` and the one on a withheld source are true for object sources. With M1 the `groupBy` sentence gains the `file` / `http` arm. "Each malformed argument is refused `VALIDATION_ERROR` (400) naming it" is true of the executor (S5).
- `content/docs/ai/knowledge-rag.mdx`, the new section, 13 sentences and the table read one by one. True: one definition, `aiExposed`, reads as the person asking; `query`, `sourceIds`, `topK` 1 to 20 default 5; `granularity`; `scope` at most 10 entries of 500 ids; the hit's members; `sources` and `refused`; an empty scope, an entry with no ids and an empty `sourceIds` refused; the 255 and NUL rule; no count returned; a withheld source answered as an absent one. False: "A source that does not list the field answers nothing for that call" (M1). True of the executor and not of the MCP door: "Each malformed argument is refused `VALIDATION_ERROR` (400), naming the argument" (S5). "The in-product agent" serving the definition: cloud#4933 is closed; not measured further by this seat.
- The definition's description: every argument and both new hit members are named; the bounds match the constants. One false clause, M1.
- PR body: the What-changes and Tests sections match the diff. Stale or untrue: the CI count; "This also covers ... an unknown key" (true of the executor only).

**修复清单** (grades are in the contract record below)
1. M1 — the description says "a source that does not index that field answers nothing for that search", and the docs and changeset repeat it. A `file` / `http` source answers under `groupBy`, one hit per document, with no `groupValue`. Say so in the description, in the docs table row and hit sentence, and in the changeset; change no behaviour.
2. S2 — one case with an exposed `file` source whose hit carries `metadata[groupBy]`: its hit has no `groupValue`. It must go red when the guard in `hitOf` is removed.
3. S3 — one case with a short unknown key and a short unknown source id holding a double quote, a newline and a NUL: the refusal carries their escapes. It must go red when `quoted` stops using `JSON.stringify`.
4. S4 — in the MCP case, compare the listed input schema, less `$schema`, with `getKnowledgeToolDefinitions()[0].parameters` by `toEqual`, so that any transport-side schema edit is red.
5. S5 — the MCP bound case asserts only "an error or `isError`". Pin what both doors answer: `isError`, a text naming `scope`, the same text on HTTP and stdio. In the docs and the PR body, say that an MCP client's schema check refuses a shape the schema states before the tool does, and that the coded refusal is the executor's.
6. nit — refresh the PR body's CI count (64 success, 11 expected skips) and drop "no dist involved".
7. nit — `SEARCH_KNOWLEDGE_MAX_SCOPE_ENTRIES` and `SEARCH_KNOWLEDGE_MAX_SCOPE_IDS` restate 10 and 500 beside `SEARCH_SCOPE_MAX_ENTRIES` and `SEARCH_SCOPE_MAX_IDS` of the same package. Derive them, or assert the two pairs equal.
8. nit — `JSON.stringify` leaves format characters such as U+202E as they are; the door counts length in UTF-16 units and a JSON Schema validator counts code points. Both are in the stricter or harmless direction.
9. nit — the description does not say that `groupValue` is the stored value and may be a string, a number or a list.

**接受的偏差**
- `@objectstack/mcp` without a changeset entry: accepted. Its three touched paths are a test, the vitest config and one `devDependencies` line; its `files` are `dist`, `README.md` and `CHANGELOG.md`, so no shipped code moves. It is in the one `fixed` group with `@objectstack/service-knowledge`, so it is versioned with this changeset anyway, and an entry would put a change in its changelog that it does not have.
- The changeset is `patch` for a widening, as #37342 was.
- The full suites of the two packages were not run by this seat.

**范围外去向**
- To file by the seat (server lane, `packages/mcp`): the SDK's input-validation refusal repeats an unknown argument key as sent, unquoted and uncut, on every MCP tool whose schema closes its keys. On `search_knowledge` the top-level case predates this PR; the scope-entry case is new with the definition's `additionalProperties: false` and is the same class. The carried rule on caller strings holds at the executor and not on this path.
- `content/docs/ai/connect-mcp.mdx`, the `search_knowledge` row: true as written, not in the claim; dropped.
- `sourceIds` item length: dropped, see ruling 3.
- The hosted in-app agent: objectstack-ai/cloud#4933 (row 13).

**落地条款**
- Clause-② declared: the contract record below is not a pass at this head. Not queued. The delta round is the description sentence with its two prose copies, and four test cases; the reviewer of this record reads the delta.
- A head that moves past prose owes a fresh record.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `1ebae53960989f6bd358a07034859776dac31625`
Local-runs: probe — the two targeted suites, 27 single-change ablations, one schema round-trip probe, one `groupBy` probe over a file source and 14 refusal probes over both MCP doors were run in a scratch worktree to test the carried security claims; nothing was pushed.
Scope: packages/services/service-knowledge/src/knowledge-tools.ts + packages/services/service-knowledge/src/__tests__/knowledge-tools.test.ts, packages/mcp/src/mcp-knowledge-tools.test.ts, packages/mcp/vitest.config.ts, packages/mcp/package.json
Security-touching: yes
Rule-change-verified: yes

### ① Derived judgments

- The contract is the one `search_knowledge` definition (K9 rule 1). The diff adds three arguments to it and two members to the hit, and no transport file changes (K9 rules 2 and 4). The arguments are the service's options of the same names, handed over unchanged; the readers landed with #37335 and #37342.
- `aiExposed` stays in the executor (K9 rule 3). The service is asked about exposed sources only, so admission, the scope terms and the group filter are never computed for a withheld source. A withheld source and an absent one give the same answer and the same adapter calls; both cases are pinned.
- The executor adds no permission and removes none (K9 rule 5): the context is passed whole, and no argument reaches a source the caller's `sourceIds` could not already reach. `scope` and `groupBy` only remove sources and hits. Record granularity widens how many passages each source is asked for, never who may read them.
- No count (K9 rule 6, K10 rule 4): the answer is `hits`, `sources` and `refused`; the whole answer is read by `toEqual` with the re-check and the scope both removing hits.
- K10 rule 3 says the index copy is for ranking and snippets. `groupValue` is a third use of it. The card asks for the group value by name (item 3) and #37103 item 3 returns it in the hit's metadata, so this follows the card. It stands behind the field gate, the caller's re-read of the record and the hash comparison, as the snippet does.
- The face this file list maps to is the declaration alone: no spec schema and no governed path is in the diff. The claim asked for the ceiling tier and this record was served there.

### ② Semver level

- `Clause-②: yes` is right: three optional arguments and two optional answer members widen a published tool contract; nothing that was accepted is refused now. The two pre-existing refusals changed text only, and their `code` and `status` are the same.
- `Metadata-protocol: none` is right: no key a metadata author writes changes.
- `@objectstack/service-knowledge` at `patch`, as #37342. `@objectstack/mcp` has no entry and ships no changed code.

### ③ Boundary flags

- The dev's three notes: ruled in the seat section. `open_questions`: none.
- SQL push-down: the diff adds no read, no id materialisation and no join. No finding.
- Existence and count: the answer under each argument is built from hits that passed the re-check; an unreadable record in scope, an absent record and an unindexed one are answered alike. The door's refusals are decided before any source is read.
- Refusal text: at the executor every repeated caller string is JSON-quoted, cut to 64 characters and capped at five, measured on six refusals. Over MCP the SDK refuses first for the shapes the schema states, and repeats an unknown key as sent. That path is not in this diff and predates it for the top-level key; it goes to a card.
- Both MCP doors: 14 refusals and 3 answers compared, the same text on HTTP and stdio each time. The listed schema equals the definition's parameters plus `$schema`.
- Author: PR `user.login` is `objectstack-fleet[bot]`.
- Overlap: none open on these files at this head.

### ④ Design judgment

`packages/services/service-knowledge/src/knowledge-tools.ts`
- The schema and the door agree on every bound, and the door is at least as strict as the service on every shape, so the service's own refusals are unreachable through the tool. Holding the bounds in the definition lets a client refuse early; the door still holds them for a caller that skips the schema.
- `hitOf` stays a member-by-member whitelist. The `groupValue` guard is the right one: object source, field listed. It is the only line that keeps a `file` / `http` adapter's metadata out of the answer, and it is unpinned (S2).
- The description is contract text. One clause of it is untrue for `file` / `http` sources (M1).
- The two constants restate the service's bounds in the same package (seat nit 7).

`packages/services/service-knowledge/src/__tests__/knowledge-tools.test.ts`
- 17 of 20 ablations turn cases red. The quoting and the guard do not (S3, S2). The third green one is a line of `main`, not of this diff.

`packages/mcp/src/mcp-knowledge-tools.test.ts`, `packages/mcp/vitest.config.ts`, `packages/mcp/package.json`
- Running the real definition and executor behind the stdio bridge is the right test: a definition that did not convert would register no tool. The alias and the devDependency follow the `service-record-context` arrangement and touch no shipped file.
- The byte comparison is between two doors that share one registration function, so it cannot see an edit made there; the comparison against the definition is partial (S4). The bound case accepts any error (S5).

M1 (must-fix) — the description, and the docs and changeset after it, say a source that does not index the `groupBy` field answers nothing; a `file` / `http` source answers one hit per document with no `groupValue`.

S2 (should-fix) — no case goes red when the `groupValue` field guard is removed.

S3 (should-fix) — no case goes red when the JSON quoting of caller strings is removed.

S4 (should-fix) — the listed schema is not compared whole with the real definition; a transport-side edit of bounds and descriptions stays green.

S5 (should-fix) — the MCP bound case pins no shape, and the docs and PR body state the coded refusal for shapes an MCP client's schema check refuses first.

Reviewed-by: `session_01JQwxbW5anP6GDaVi5LKi2U`

**VERDICT: FAIL**

## 维护者速读

- 这是上一轮退回后的复核。上一轮指出的问题都已改好：工具说明、文档和变更说明里那句与实际不符的话已改成实情（按字段分组时，记录类知识源没有该字段就不返回，文件和网页类知识源仍按文档各返回一条）；三处原先没有测试守住的安全行为现在都有测试，改坏会报警。
- 这一轮只动了说明文字、测试，以及两个上限数字改为直接取自检索服务，没有改任何行为。
- 复核结论：通过，可以排队合并。这个版本的自动检查全部为绿。
- 需要您做的：无。

## 席位核对

ACCEPT — the five findings of round 1 are closed at this head, each by a case that goes red when its line is removed, and the delta changes no behaviour. Every check at the head is green or an expected skip. One nit is declined with a reason and stays an accepted deviation.

Head-sha: `44e00dcf1b4ff8bdda1910184d03f2c0fbed1ea7`

Delta review: one commit on `1ebae53960989f6bd358a07034859776dac31625`, no force push; 5 files, +80 / -15. The PR against its merge base `db77cc49`: the same 8 files, +778 / -17. The rest stands as read in round 1 (PR comment 7180869252). Head re-read at 2026-11-26T02:58Z: unchanged.

**形态**
- Open, draft, base `main`, first line `Fixes #37311`, the only closing keyword in the body. Body and changeset read `Clause-②: yes` · `Metadata-protocol: none`.
- Not governed surface: `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 37393` reads 0 of 8 paths on the register, 795 changed lines, under the 3000 threshold.
- The delta touches the changeset, the docs page, the two test files and `knowledge-tools.ts`. No transport source file, no `package.json`, no lockfile. All inside the claim.
